subject: Request: Provisional Net120 to Quarterly Transition — Vectara Bridge
messages:
From: Ayesha Khan <ayesha@vectara.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vectara Finance <finance@vectara.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payment cadence request — alignment with Q4 fiscal plan

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency and cost controls. We're in procurement review and need to align billing to our treasury schedule. Finance is asking whether Redwood can accommodate a provisional Net-120 for the first 90 days while we finish our audit, then move to quarterly invoices thereafter.

Key context:
- Annual contract, $468k ARR (see attached SOW).
- Procurement requires Net-120 for initial onboarding due to vendor approval cycle.
- They will set up a PO but need the extended remit window; finance prefers to move to quarterly billing after the first quarter.

Can Redwood consider a provisional Net-120 for the onboarding period with these guardrails: pre-authorized PO in place, usage cap of $80k until PO clears, and a one-time security deposit if needed? If you need any docs from our side I can get them to you today.

Attachments: Vectara_SOW_v3.pdf, VECTARA_PAYMENT_PLAN.xlsx

Best,
Ayesha
Ayesha Khan
Head of Procurement, Vectara
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Ayesha Khan <ayesha@vectara.ai>
Cc: Vectara Finance <finance@vectara.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payment cadence request — alignment with Q4 fiscal plan

Hi Ayesha — thanks for the context and attachments. I’ve looped in finance and our deal desk to evaluate. On the surface we can explore a provisional Net-120 for an onboarding window but we’ll need an approved mutual action plan (M.A.P.), a PO on file, and a conditional credit hold if usage exceeds the agreed cap.

I’ll escalate for an executive decision today. Expect next steps from me by end of day tomorrow.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Vectara — provisional Net-120 request (DEAL-4541) — need exec/finance signoff

Team — forwarding Vectara's ask. Summary below and proposed conditional approval to get into onboarding while procurement completes audit.

Why this matters: 1) $468k ARR strategic prospect in vector search space; high expansion potential. 2) Competitive risk: they are evaluating two providers, onboarding speed is a differentiator.

External ask: provisional Net-120 for first 90 days, then move to quarterly invoicing. PO will be provided; usage capped at $80k until PO/credit check cleared.

Proposed guardrails (suggested by Deal Desk):
- Conditional provisional Net-120 for 90 days only.
- Require signed M.A.P. (milestones + usage cap) pre-onboard.
- Holdback clause: once usage exceeds $80k, automatically place account on restricted service until deposit/PO clears.
- Finance proviso: if Net-120 is approved, Vectara must provide a security deposit equal to 25% of first quarter commitment or provide a corporate guarantee.
- Review checkpoint at day 60 to confirm PO progress; auto-revert to standard net30 if PO not received by day 90.

Risks: cashflow exposure, collections overhead, precedent for other mid-market deals.

Requested approvals:
- Laura: finance terms and deposit requirement
- Jonas: commercial signoff for conditional net timing + any discount implications
- Marissa: final exec consent for provisional terms

Attachments: Vectara_SOW_v3.pdf, VECTARA_PAYMENT_PLAN.xlsx

Thanks — Rishi
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2027 11:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vectara — provisional Net-120 request (DEAL-4541) — need exec/finance signoff

Rishi / team — I reviewed the numbers and Vectara's credit profile (linked in HubSpot). Finance is uncomfortable with a straight Net-120 without collateral. I support the proposed conditional approach with the following edits:

1) Increase security deposit to 30% of Q1 committed spend (reduces cash exposure).
2) Add an auto-invoice clause: we invoice monthly but accept payment terms at Net-120; invoices will be issued monthly to maintain AR workflow.
3) Require an irrevocable PO within 30 days or restart the approval process — no automatic extensions.

If commercial is OK with those edits, I’ll schedule a quick sign-off call with Marissa to finalize executeable language.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Finance — Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 7 Oct 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vectara — provisional Net-120 request (DEAL-4541) — need exec/finance signoff

Approving provisional Net-120 with the guardrails below — Marissa (exec sign-off):

- Term: Net-120 for first 90 days only.
- Deposit: 30% of Q1 committed spend to be received before access is escalated above $80k usage cap.
- Billing workflow: Redwood will issue monthly invoices; Vectara may remit on Net-120 at treasury discretion.
- PO requirement: irrevocable PO within 30 days of SOW signature; if not received, Redwood will restrict service and revert to net30 billing terms until PO/guarantee provided.
- Review: Finance and AE to review at day-60 to confirm progress and either transition to quarterly billing or cancel provisional terms.

Rishi — please communicate these conditions back to Ayesha and capture acceptance in the M.A.P. before provisioning. If they accept, Legal should include the auto-invoice and deposit clauses in the SOW amendment.

Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
